subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after_compaction hooks gain a permanent public resetSession API, and if so should the contract be only resetSession(reason?) or also retain the explicit-session-key overload from unmerged prior work?
rationale: Current main has no shipped hook reset API, and the explicit-key form traces to a closed unmerged proposal, so code review cannot decide the permanent plugin contract from compatibility assumptions alone.

options.title: Adopt reason-only hook API
options.body: Expose resetSession(reason?) only on resettable after_compaction contexts and keep all session-key and queue authority internal to core.

options.title: Retain explicit-key overload
options.body: Publish both signatures with documentation and compatibility tests, accepting the larger permanent plugin contract despite no shipped dependency.

options.title: Do not add the hook API
options.body: Keep reset orchestration in core or a narrower owner-specific seam and close or redesign this public plugin surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt reason-only hook API
recommendation.body: Expose resetSession(reason?) only on resettable after_compaction contexts and keep all session-key and queue authority internal to core.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice directly depends on the gateway session-reset lifecycle and the long-term authority exposed to plugins.
